reviews.review_description:
Don't get me wrong, this is a fantastic game. However, it fails to match what made the previous game, Leapers, so popular. I came back to that game often because it had many other things to do. The community was very kind, so it was nice to chat in multi-player and speed running the levels brought an entire new element to the game; competition. This game isn't very well made, having ripped off the hands from Gandalf's Nextbots and not having any replayability.

On its own, it's a good game. But it fails to keep me coming back to it like I did with Leapers.
This game is really fun to play with lots of worlds and levels. This is basically Mario in VR!
